description: From the root revision, Tokenizer.decode documents a string return for batch size one but returns a one-element list for every rank-two one-row tensor; the mismatch persists unchanged at commit 40fb78f.
trigger: Pass a rank-two tensor with one row to Tokenizer.decode.
expected_behavior: The documented contract returns a string when batch size is one.
actual_behavior: The rank-two branch always constructs and returns a list, including for one row.

introductions.scope: The conflicting docstring and rank-two return branch are present in the root tree.

observations.source: Commit 31 authoring finding and independent Fable mailbox review.
observations.reach: The mismatch is directly reachable through the public decode method for a rank-two one-row tensor.
observations.limits: External callers were not inventoried and tensor execution was not performed.

limits: No repository tokenizer or tensor code was executed.
External decode callers were not inventoried.
The finding concerns the stated public return contract, not backend tokenization.

source.artifact: Root and commit-31 tokenizer decode source scan

impact.rationale: The return type differs from the docstring for one input rank; no external-caller impact was inventoried.

administrative_review_status: Commit-31 inherited finding independently confirmed by Fable; ledger candidate awaits independent review.
